briefs.summary: FastAPI is a modern, fast (high‑performance) web framework for building APIs with Python based on standard Python type hints. It combines high performance, easy coding, and standards‑based features such as OpenAPI and JSON Schema.

api.name: FastAPI
api.example:
from fastapi import FastAPI

app = FastAPI()

api.name: @app.get
api.summary: Decorator to declare a GET endpoint on the FastAPI app.

api.name: fastapi dev
api.summary: CLI command that reads the main file, detects the FastAPI app, and starts a development server with auto‑reload using Uvicorn.

api.name: uv add
api.summary: Installs FastAPI with the standard set of optional dependencies.

gotchas: Make sure to put "fastapi[standard]" in quotes when using uv to ensure it works in all terminals.
If your code uses async/await, define endpoints with async def; otherwise use regular def.
The `fastapi dev` command enables auto‑reload by default, which is intended for local development only.

briefs.summary: Uvicorn is an ASGI web server implementation for Python. It currently supports HTTP/1.1 and WebSockets.

api.name: uvicorn.run
api.example:
import uvicorn

async def app(scope, receive, send):
    ...

if __name__ == "__main__":
    uvicorn.run("main:app", port=5000, log_level="info")

api.name: uvicorn.Config
api.example:
import uvicorn

async def app(scope, receive, send):
    ...

if __name__ == "__main__":
    config = uvicorn.Config("main:app", port=5000, log_level="info")
    server = uvicorn.Server(config)
    server.run()

api.name: uvicorn.Server
api.example:
import uvicorn

async def app(scope, receive, send):
    ...

if __name__ == "__main__":
    config = uvicorn.Config("main:app", port=5000, log_level="info")
    server = uvicorn.Server(config)
    server.run()

api.name: uvicorn.Server.serve
api.example:
import asyncioimport uvicorn

async def app(scope, receive, send):
    ...

async def main():
    config = uvicorn.Config("main:app", port=5000, log_level="info")
    server = uvicorn.Server(config)
    await server.serve()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())

gotchas: The `uvicorn.workers` module is deprecated and will be removed in a future release.
When using Gunicorn, install the `uvicorn-worker` package (`python -m pip install uvicorn-worker`).

briefs.install: pip install multipart or uv add multipart
briefs.summary: The python-multipart module provides a fast incremental non‑blocking parser for multipart/form‑data, as defined by HTML5 and RFC7578. It also offers blocking alternatives for WSGI or CGI applications via a buffered parser and high‑level WSGI helper functions.
gotchas: Only supports multipart/form-data; multipart/mixed is not supported
No base64 or quoted‑printable transfer encoding is handled
Encoded‑word or name=_charset_ markers are not supported
The parsers do not handle clearly broken client inputs such as invalid line breaks or headers

briefs.summary: pypdf is a free and open source pure‑python PDF library capable of splitting, merging, cropping, and transforming the pages of PDF files. It can also add custom data, viewing options, passwords, and retrieve text and metadata from PDFs.

api.name: PdfReader
api.example:
from pypdf import PdfReader

reader = PdfReader("example.pdf")number_of_pages = len(reader.pages)page = reader.pages[0]text = page.extract_text()

gotchas: For AES encryption or decryption, install extra dependencies with `pip install pypdf[crypto]`.
`pypdf` 3.1.0 and above include significant improvements; consult the migration guide when upgrading.
Use `print(pypdf.__version__)` to determine the installed version.

briefs.summary: Sentence Transformers (a.k.a. SBERT) is the go-to Python module for using and training state-of-the-art embedding and reranker models. It can compute embeddings from text, images, audio, or video, calculate similarity scores with Cross‑Encoder models, generate sparse embeddings, and produce token‑level embeddings for ColBERT‑style retrieval using Multi‑Vector Encoder models.

api.name: CrossEncoder.predict
api.example:
scores = model.predict([(query, passage) for passage in passages])
print(scores)  # => [8.607139 5.506266 6.352977]

api.name: CrossEncoder.rank

gotchas: Requires Python 3.10+ and PyTorch 2.2+ with transformers v5.0+.
Installation extras are available for image, audio, video, training, ONNX, OpenVINO, and development support.
Version 6.0 introduces MultiVectorEncoder and may require migration steps as described in the migration guide.

briefs.summary: Faiss is a library for efficient similarity search and clustering of dense vectors. It contains algorithms that search in sets of vectors of any size, up to ones that possibly do not fit in RAM. It also contains supporting code for evaluation and parameter tuning.
gotchas: Note that either package should be installed, but not both, as the latter is a superset of the former.

briefs.summary: NumPy is the fundamental package for scientific computing with Python. It provides powerful N-dimensional arrays, vectorized operations, and a comprehensive suite of mathematical functions.

plan_draft.title: FastAPI Resume Ranking Service Plan
plan_draft.overview: Create a FastAPI microservice that accepts PDF resumes, extracts their text, embeds the content with a SentenceTransformer model, and ranks the resumes against a job description using a FAISS index. The plan covers environment setup, API implementation, PDF processing, embedding, similarity search, and verification.

phases.title: Project Setup
phases.body:
- Initialize a new project directory and version control.
- Add FastAPI with standard extras via `uv add "fastapi[standard]"`[^fastapi-1].
- Add python-multipart via `uv add multipart`[^python-multipart-1].
- Install pypdf, sentence-transformers, faiss-cpu, and numpy using pip or conda as documented[^pypdf-1][^sentence-transformers-1][^faiss-cpu-1][^numpy-1].
- Create `main.py` as the entry point.
- Record dependencies in `pyproject.toml` or `requirements.txt`.

phases.title: API Skeleton
phases.body:
- Import FastAPI and instantiate `app = FastAPI()`[^fastapi-1].
- Define a GET `/health` endpoint returning `{"status":"ok"}`.
- Define an async POST `/extract` endpoint accepting `file: UploadFile = File(...)`[^python-multipart-1].
- Ensure the endpoint reads the file with `await file.read()`.
- Return a JSON payload with a placeholder for extracted text.
- Add `if __name__ == "__main__": uvicorn.run("main:app", port=8000, log_level="info")`[^uvicorn-1].

phases.title: PDF Extraction
phases.body:
- Write a helper `def extract_text_from_pdf(data: bytes) -> str:`.
- Inside the helper, create a `BytesIO` stream and instantiate `PdfReader` from pypdf[^pypdf-1].
- Iterate over `reader.pages`, call `page.extract_text()`, and concatenate non‑None results.
- Return the combined string; raise HTTPException if no text is found.
- Call this helper from the `/extract` endpoint and include the result in the response.
- Add appropriate imports from `pypdf` and `io`.

phases.title: Embedding Service
phases.body:
- At module load, create a global `model = SentenceTransformer("sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2")`[^sentence-transformers-1].
- Implement `def embed_texts(texts: List[str]) -> np.ndarray:` that returns `model.encode(texts, convert_to_numpy=True)`[^numpy-1].
- Add a POST `/rank` endpoint receiving JSON with `job_description: str` and `resumes: List[str]`.
- Inside the endpoint, compute `job_emb = embed_texts([job_description])` and `resume_emb = embed_texts(resumes)`.
- Store embeddings in memory for the ranking step.
- Return a response confirming embeddings were generated.

phases.title: Similarity Index & Ranking
phases.body:
- Import FAISS and create an index: `index = faiss.IndexFlatL2(job_emb.shape[1])`[^faiss-cpu-1].
- Add resume embeddings to the index via `index.add(resume_emb)`.
- Perform a search: `distances, ids = index.search(job_emb, k=len(resumes))`.
- Convert L2 distances to similarity scores (e.g., `scores = -distances.squeeze()`).
- Build a ranked list of resumes with their scores and return it in the `/rank` response.
- Validate that the dimension of `job_emb` matches the index dimension; raise an error otherwise.

phases.title: Run & Verify
phases.body:
- Start the service in development mode with `uv run fastapi dev`[^fastapi-1].
- Use `curl -F "file=@sample.pdf" http://localhost:8000/extract` to test PDF extraction.
- POST a JSON payload to `/rank` containing a job description and the extracted resume texts; verify the returned order reflects relevance.
- Add basic logging statements for each request.
- Document the startup command and required environment variables in a README.
- Commit all code and ensure the test commands pass.

pitfalls: Missing quotes around "fastapi[standard]" in the `uv add` command will cause installation errors[^fastapi-1].
Defining the endpoint with `def` instead of `async def` while using `await file.read()` blocks the event loop[^fastapi-1].
`page.extract_text()` can return `None` for scanned PDFs; filter out None values to avoid empty strings[^pypdf-1].
Sentence‑Transformer models need PyTorch 2.2+; absence of a compatible torch version raises import errors[^sentence-transformers-1].
FAISS‑CPU is only distributed via conda; installing it with pip may lead to missing native libraries[^faiss-cpu-1].
Large PDF uploads may exhaust memory; consider imposing size limits or streaming processing.
